sentences.text:
By way of the present application, the applicant seeks grant of interim bail during the pendency of her regular bail application, in case arising out of FIR bearing No. 412/2023, dated 27.08.2023,
registered at Police Station Ashok Vihar, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 420/467/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
9.
Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
10. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant states that the applicant is in judicial custody since the last one and half month.
It is stated that the husband of the application has unfortunately passed-away today morning i.e. 27.03.2026 and his last rites are to be conducted today itself.
Therefore, it is prayed that interim bail be granted to the applicant.

11. The learned APP appearing on behalf of the State, on instructions from the concerned Investigating Officer (I.O.) states that the factum of death of the husband of the applicant has been verified.

12. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the present case, also keeping in mind the factum of death of the husband of the applicant, this Court is inclined to grant interim bail to the applicant for a period of one week from the date of his release, subject to following conditions:
i) The applicant shall furnish a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- with one surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 27/03/2026 at 22:52:13 of the concerned Metropolitan Magistrate/Duty Metropolitan Magistrate.
ii) The applicant shall surrender her passport, and will not leave the country during this period.
iii) The applicant shall also provide her mobile number to the Jail Superintendent, as well as I.O./S.H.O. concerned, which shall be kept operational at all times.
iv) The applicant shall appear before the concerned I.O./S.H.O. once in a week during the period of interim bail.
v) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity during the period of interim bail.
13. Accordingly, the present interim bail application stands disposed of.
14. Dasti under signatures of the Court Master.
